name: iitk-autowala
description: Availability discovery for auto drivers on the IIT Kanpur campus.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @iitk-autowala/api && npm run build --workspace @iitk-autowala/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspace @iitk-autowala/api
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed --workspace @iitk-autowala/api
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
